words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 这是我要去的具体地址。(Zhè shì wǒ yào qù de jùtǐ dìzhǐ.) — This is the specific address I want to go to.
开车到机场大概要多长时间？(Kāichē dào jīchǎng dàgài yào duō cháng shíjiān?) — About how long does driving to the airport take?
这是您的房卡，电梯需要刷卡。(Zhè shì nín de fángkǎ, diàntī xūyào shuākǎ.) — Here is your room card, elevator requires tapping.
入住需要交两百块押金。(Rùzhù xūyào jiāo liǎng bǎi kuài yājīn.) — Checking in requires a 200 yuan deposit.
请问明天的早餐几点开始？(Qǐngwèn míngtiān de zǎocān jǐ diǎn kāishǐ?) — What time does breakfast start tomorrow?
走到十字路口往左拐。(Zǒu dào shízì lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.) — Walk to the intersection and turn left.
穿过马路然后往右拐。(Chuānguò mǎlù ránhòu wǎng yòu guǎi.) — Cross the street then turn right.
沿着这条街一直往直走五百米。(Yánzhe zhè tiáo jiē yìzhí wǎng zhí zǒu wǔ bǎi mǐ.) — Walk straight ahead along this street for 500 meters.
师傅，就在前面路口停，到了。(Shīfu, jiù zài qiánmian lùkǒu tíng, dào le.) — Driver, please stop at the front intersection, we're here.
车站有寄存大件行李的地方吗？(Chēzhàn yǒu jìcún dàjiàn xíngli de dìfang ma?) — Is there a luggage storage area at the station?
路不熟的时候找警察问路最安全。(Lù bù shú de shíhou zhǎo jǐngchá wèn lù zuì ānquán.) — When unfamiliar with the route, asking police for directions is safest.
您的航班在十六号登机口登机。(Nín de hángbān zài shíliù hào dēngjīkǒu dēngjī.) — Your flight is boarding at gate 16.
从北京坐高铁到上海只要四个多小时。(Cóng Běijīng zuò gāotiě dào Shànghǎi zhǐ yào sì ge duō xiǎoshí.) — High-speed rail from Beijing to Shanghai takes only 4+ hours.
刷交通一卡通坐地铁非常方便。(Shuā jiāotōng yīkǎtōng zuò dìtiě fēicháng fāngbiàn.) — Tapping the transit metro card is very convenient.
出门旅行随身带上应急药品。(Chūmén lǚxíng suíshēn dài shang yìngjí yàopǐn.) — Carry contingency medicines when traveling.
发车前十五分钟开始在三号检票口检票。(Fāchē qián shíwǔ fēnzhōng kāishǐ zài sān hào jiǎnpiàokǒu jiǎnpiào.) — Ticket checking starts 15 minutes before departure at gate 3.
在下一站换乘地铁二号线。(Zài xià yí zhàn huànchéng dìtiě èr hào xiàn.) — Transfer to Metro Line 2 at the next station.
我们在火车站南出站口碰头。(Wǒmen zài huǒchēzhàn nán chūzhànkǒu pèngtóu.) — We'll meet at the south exit gate of the train station.
如有遗失物品请去大厅问询处。(Rú yǒu yíshī wùpǐn qǐng qù dàtīng wènxúnchù.) — For lost items, please visit the hall information desk.
